notes.title: Prison Survival Playtests Has Begun!
notes.content:
Hello Prisoners!


We're excited to announce that playtests for Prison Survival are now live!


You can join starting today, July 24, until August 7.

To join the playtest, simply visit our Prison Survival's Steam page and click “Request Access” - access will be granted automatically.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983910/"][/dynamiclink]


 🔥What is in this playtest? 

Prison Survival is a first-person prison stealth-action game set in a semi-open prison environment. 
You’re free to explore – but some areas are off-limits. 
Enter a Restricted Area, and guards or security cameras will be on your tail. 
If they catch you – you're sent back to a checkpoint.

You can run, hide, or use parkour to escape – climb pipes, ledges, or sneak through ventilation shafts. You can also fight other inmates with your fists!

The art style is slightly stylized, but we’re keeping the gritty prison atmosphere: gangs, drugs, fights, foul language, and the daily grind of prison life!


[previewyoutube="wKjJcNnzYjo;full"][/previewyoutube]



🔥 What is your goal in Prison Survial Playtest?

You work for a prison boss. Your job? Smuggle contraband – drugs, weapons, and other illegal items.
Pick up orders, avoid or take down guards, use parkour, disable cameras, fight rival inmates, deliver the goods and get back to your cell and go to sleep ;)

You can also buy helpful tools (like lockpicks, remote camera disablers, or a map), or train parkour in a dedicated area!


📢 Join Our Community!

Visit our Discord for FAQ, control explanations, and to grab the press kit !


📋Deliver your message!

Press F5 during a game to report a bug or a suggestion!
We need your feedback! Help us and become a part of Prison Survival!

CLICK HERE TO FILL A QUESTIONNAIRE !

 👀Invite your friends!
Once you gain access to the playtest, you’ll be able to use Steam’s new feature to bring your friends… straight to prison 😉 Don't hesitate to invite your firends to Prison Survival Playtest!

------------------
Take care, inmates!
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Inside the Gameplay: Even more Prison Guard Daily Routines PART 2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/72cb15d6d04da37a3c9064bab29abc6037a0ff3a.jpg
I hope you're ready to learn what else awaits you in the full version of Prison Simulator.
The game launches on November 4th exclusively on Steam.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0d7891c4ddfb1bd6e0591a68a0a7105938725704.jpg
Workshop
While in Prison, all inmates have is time. So why not make them more productive and earn some cash for the Prison? So each day bunch of inmates works shifts in the workshop. 

Your role is to pick the perfect guys for the tasks. (If you screw this up and select the members of rival gangs, they will beat the shit out of each other). 
Assign them to their stations and make sure that all of them actually work. 

But you know how it is. Accidents happen, and someone might get hurt; there are times when they might misuse the blowtorch (def not by accident), and you'll need to search for your inner firefighter. 

But you can always decide to make your prisoners work overtime to work off the damage. The decision is yours.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d5805d37c8a067212f9e4e6de2f400a7d033ca89.jpg
Searching packages
Drugs, tools, weapons. You won't believe what these convicts will get in their packages. And their close ones tend to be very creative in smuggling prohibited items. So your job is to search through all the boxes. 
If you overlook anything - your fellow prison guards will lose respect for ya. Things might get ugly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b7d160008303a5f9024607bac6c18b3a7c4d7642.jpg
Visiting Room

Family and friends visiting the Prisoners is their only occasion to have contact with the outside world. But you know – Prison is the place where Convicts should obey rules. And one rule about having guests is that – you cannot spend there all day. Your job is to make sure that the visit is not too long and that you keep your inmates' emotions in check. (yup, especially those negative ones)
 
But you know – as a Prison Guard, you have a choice. You can let someone sit a bit longer (for a bribe ofc), but it may come with a price. Of what kind? You can check for yourself.
 
Did I mention that this Prison also has a special room for more "intimate encounters"? 😉
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6ea28a45390a7c220a2af1a516f5ea33b04f0f36.jpg
Monitoring

Observe your Inmates and check if they're not doing anything malicious. In case of any suspicious behaviors – look for the closest CO and guide him. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/3bf611841a937720e63f22a94d96585d5fc578b0.jpg
Checking the applications
 
Prisoners have a right to ask for a release due to special occasions like a funeral. Sometimes they want to file a complaint or a request.
And some of them are filing for a pardon. So you have to dig through that paper, check all the signatures, stamps, and content of these documents before you Approve or Deny someone's application. 

Double-check – cause mistakes in this field have consequences.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ecfaae96ea45e338e32e7519476c3c67dda23030.jpg
 Execution
 
Among all your Prisoners, there will be ones who committed the most brutal crimes. The only journey that waits for them is the one to the Death Cell. And your job is to escort them… and manage the whole process. While the entire experience is rather grim, there're rules and you need to ensure that everything is in check.
 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/9ce0e63ff392aba27cf572b27fedda1eb6156be4.jpg
Releasing the Prisoners
 
Before you release a Prisoner, you need to follow the utmost detail of the procedure. Check if all documents are correct, search him. If everything is ok – you're good to give him back his belongings and release him to the rest of the society.

notes.title: Inside Gameplay: Prison Guard Daily Routines PART 1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0138274a3aa2ce2db0b97075bfc78ca5286045cc.jpg

I bet you're curious about all the things you'll be able to do in the full version of Prison Simulator. So without further ado - let's dive into all the Routines you need to perform as a Prison Guard. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e00de33e0bbb1f7c9c4b6fd6537ee8cdf6c8f10e.jpg
Cell Shakedown

You don't want any contraband and illegal stuff to go unnoticed under your command, do you? So check out every inch of the cells. 
Trust me - inmates are desperate. They will hide stuff even in the shitter. 
Once you find some hidden stashes, it's up to you to decide what are you gonna do with your findings. 

Are you gonna do the right thing and confiscate the stashed stuff? Or maybe you'll leave it where it was? Or take it for yourself? 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/948233e4d46c316bc35ffecf4987feb8eec15c81.jpg
Prisoners' Reception

You're the "Welcome Committee " for the new Prisoners. Your job as a Prison Guard is to make sure that you're taking in the right guy. That means - fingerprints and documentation checks. (You don't want to bring in the wrong guy, do you?) 
Check the personal items that the new guy wants to bring in (you won't believe what people can smuggle in a shampoo bottle). 
Give away the pack of basic supplies and wish "good luck" to this poor sod. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/44bef1ce7316aa98e0b1eb715c4599f53be4618a.jpg
Prison Yard

Even these poor Jail bastards need to take a breath of fresh air. But don't forget that they're still a bunch of degenerates who need constant supervision. So have an eye on everyone. Stop the fights! Punish the vandals! 
Hell - you can even order them to get back in the cells if they don't know how to behave. You're calling the shots. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b23e29b4a6bd85c964a1bad4a10c2d985b82b5bf.jpg
Cafeteria 
 
You need to make sure that no one will start a riot over the spoon of a mush. So maintain peace and order at any cost. No fights, shouting in the mess hall. So if any of that happens, you need to be swift on your feet and act quickly. 
If it seems that they won't obey, you're allowed to use force. Or try to solve the problem verbally. It's up to you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/61b09759763821f596fbe11680939ad40f5a31fc.jpg
Attendance Check

The best way to check is if you don't have any fugitives here. First, arm yourself with your trusty clicker. Then, open every cell in the block and start the counting. Of course, some of your Prisoners won't cooperate. That's where you need to use your "persuasion" techniques. You can either yell at someone, make him step out of his cell, or just count him either way. Your choice.

But remember - you need to have them in check. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d90536199fdc607be6104cfea644e2f378ca8253.jpg
Shower

I'm waiting for all the jokes in the comments ;) 
But srsly - hygiene is essential. Every person who has been in the men's locker room knows that. Here is no different. There are too many inmates and too few showers. So your job is to assign prisoners to empty cabins. Check out the washed-out and still make sure that they are on their best behavior. Is someone taking too much time, and that makes everyone waiting and getting angry? You know what to do - act as a Prison Guard would. 

This is the first part of the quick look at the Routines available in the full version of Prison Simulator.

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Prologue - Achievements Reveal
notes.content:
Hello Guards,

You've been working very diligently these past few months, the inmates even tolerate you, but...

Can you handle the latest challenge that Prison Simulator: Prologue will throw at you? Can you get them all?

All right, enough with the serious motivational speech, time for Friday's news!

In Prison Simulator: Prologue you will be able to see some of the achievements that you are familiar with from the demo version. The decision to include them in the next part was based on the complexity of the gameplay in the prologue itself.

Which of the achievements will return, you will see for yourselves, in the meantime we will present to you the achievements that you don't know yet.

1.Not on my watch!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/105062088b9aa9b87d511d1752998f69dee444c4.png

This achievement is one of the easiest and hardest at the same time. To get it, all you have to do (or as much as) is master rebellion. Simple right? Not one daredevil has tried to do it, but not one has fallen in the fight against the convicts.

2 - Diplomat

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e4872f0b03184e27b0bc03005dec1d3f2f77ecee.png

What's there to say. We solve problems with talk, not fists. So much for that. And if you don't like talking, there are only fists left, but this achievement won't be for you.

3 No guns allowed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e4b5ee4845e4a9679f2c51f4f6dfb052ee08e403.png

This achievement is reserved for true professionals. The prison is on fire, the convicts are vandalizing everything they can, the guards are running scared... and in the middle of it all - YOU. The hero of the prison, the guard of all guards, who deals with such problems without reaching for a gun. Is it a dream or a reality?

4. The story begins

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2abcf9b934d522711c19e7a81752a41692411bb3.png

This achievement is for persistent players who complete Prison Simulator: Prologue. And that's it. 

5. Finders keepers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2a1e45cd8bd89ff06bc00b095ea9d9a0f68adbee.png

Fortunately, our prison facility... Oops, it's not that easy!

6. Student

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8f3a48ef6c8dc95dcdc5a8d94c0f86dc7d468524.png

Remember those days when you went to school? Or do you still go to school? This achievement will make you feel like you're in a real... we're kidding.

Purchase the first skill to unlock this achievement. This skill will REALLY come in handy for you.

7. Rambo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/75c3cc390a98acf24e676149bbe863074c2ce7bf.png

I don't think we need to explain...


That's all we wanted to show you today. 
Let us know in the comments which achievement you like best!

And if you've earned all of the achievements while playing the demo, join our Discord server where we look forward to seeing your screenshots!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b3f6f33f04fc3e96c985cbc03392b5f70fec42d9.gif

Cheers!

It is Monday again and we know that many of you are out of energy, but we have good news for you!

First dialogue with Richard tells us that we came back to work just after a huge Riot. As you could see on one of our trailers, this is not a playground. Prisoners are furious, aggressive and they don't want to stop destroying everything.
